profile.headline: Software Engineer • Backend (Java, Spring Boot) • Frontend (React, Vue.js) • FullStack Developer
profile.summary:
Innovative IT professional with extensive experience building products and computer software from start to finish, launching products, and designing and developing API. Approachable team player with proven success collaborating cross-functionally. Proven success troubleshooting and finding solutions to software issues. Utilize communication skills to align products with business requirements.

As a developer, I help companies by delivering solutions that are optimized, reliable, and have a UI that is tailored towards the needs of the users. Through my strong verbal and written skills, I am highly proficient in gathering requirements and working with others to build a high quality product.

Core Competencies:
Debugging | Web Application Development | Test Driven Development | Coding

Technical Skills:
Languages:	Java, HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript
Frameworks:	Spring Boot, Vue.js, React, AWS, Bootstrap
Databases:	MySQL, PostgreSQL
Tools:	Git, GitHub, SonarQube, Jenkins, Jira
Methodologies:	Restful API Design, Test Driven Development

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Diagnosed and deployed a hotfix for a critical deserialization bug, improving platform stability and mitigating CI/CD pipeline risk.

• Developed and launched the reusable secret reader library, providing a streamlined interface for reading and caching AWS secrets to standardize and simplify secret management.

•Led the Dev Exchange onboarding process, deploying five new endpoints and assisting with two others, becoming the team’s go-to resource for new component creation.

• Partnered cross-functionally with the UI team to optimize API efficiency by reducing excessive HTTP calls impacting service SLOs.

• Leveraged data-driven insights and several design iterations to produce a clear architectural diagram for infrastructure vulnerability collection and audit report generation.

• Gained hands-on experience with AWS services including SQS, Secrets Manager, ECS (Fargate), Lambda, DynamoDB, and CloudFormation stacks to build scalable backend solutions.

• Utilized OnePipelineUI to create new components (including Lambda functions, library packages, and Fargate containers) and configured AWS infrastructure via a YAML file.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Software Design · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Spring Boot

positions.title: Health and well-being
positions.description: Dedicated time to personal development and skill enhancement, including professional courses and full-stack project work with React and Spring Boot. Also focused on building sustainable habits for long-term well-being and performance.

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
• Created 3+ UI components for the MyNextVehicle product launch

• Assisted the junior developers with a variety of technical issues/questions that arose

• Pair programmed with other developers daily in order to facilitate better communication to tackle development challenges as well as eliminate code reviews

• Maintained the standard compliance of SonarQube code coverage but utilizing test driven development and writing tests for both the front and backend
positions.insights: Skills: SQL · Spring Boot · Vue.js · JavaScript · Java

positions.title: Back End Developer
positions.description:
• Implemented a series of linters in Java to ensure that YAML content was in the expected format. Content could be validated either through an API or Git Workflow if pushed to the repo

• Updated a series of serverless functions via AWS to support insert, update, and delete operations through the front-end

• Worked with a serverless based architecture and got more experience AWS services such as Stacks, API Gateway
positions.insights: Skills: Spring Boot · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · AWS Lambda · Java

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Utilized Vert.x to perform event-driven non-blocking async calls to store profile templates for reuse across a Java application

• Debugged a series of API calls to resolve an issue regarding slow and invalid data retrieval. Also adjusted the page to lazy load in case of timeout
positions.insights: Skills: Spring Boot · Vert.x · React.js · Java

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
• Built an ICO registration portal that led to over 150 users registering and raised $4.5 million

• Completed a webpage that would be displayed at a kiosk to validate a user’s credentials. Functionality included performing a KYC, facial recognition scan, and verifying the data on the block chain

• Modernized the front-end code by implementing the Vue CLI (command line interface) which enabled rapid prototyping, minification of all client side assets, and cleaner code

• Created and deployed the website portion of a new product, ShoDoc, in less than 3 weeks which allowed users to sign documents electronically

• Implemented quality of life improvements such as replacing a polling system with web sockets, adding additional JUnit tests, and modularizing as well as standardizing API end points

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Delivered 4500+ tax forms by building a Java program to load and send the forms via electronic signature. Saved 450 overtime man-hours and eliminated the manual paper process

• Eliminated 165 hours of additional processing time each month by removing a redundant phase in the process flow of a .NET application responsible for collecting and maintaining vendor data

• Constructed an admin tool using HTML5/PHP that could transfer users and their electronic documents from one account to another. Transferred 2,000+ users and 30,000+ files

• Led a small group consisting of 2 other new hires to gather requirements, design, and develop a Joomla website that was to replace our current outdated developer SharePoint

• Enhanced an employee search mobile web app by standardizing the UI to match our other similar apps and adding a screen for step-by-step instructions to reach an employee’s campus

• Developed a mobile web app using HTML5, CSS3, and jQuery Mobile which enabled project managers to view their assigned projects on their phones in a simple yet intuitive interface

• Provided a quick summary of log metric files downloaded from an Ariba Server in graph format by creating a Java Swing application using the JFreeChart library to display the metrics

• Developed a Drupal Website to provide information to employees about a new company tool which they could register to use on the site

positions.title: Java Developer (Intern)
positions.description:
• Automated a manual process of downloading a file from a server, editing it using Microsoft Access, and uploading it to another server by creating a Java program which runs on a cloud task scheduler once a month. Application has been running monthly with 0 critical issues for over 2.5 years

• Set up meetings with business to discuss requirements and gather feedback

• Created documentation including a flow chart, sequence diagram, and an analysis/design document

• Gained invaluable knowledge by experiencing the full Software Development Life Cycle
